claims: Rosalía joins the cast of Euphoria Season 3.
Rosalía plays the character "Magick" in Euphoria Season 3.
"Magick" is a performer at a club called the Silver Slipper.
Rosalía's character wears a crystal-adorned orthopaedic neck brace.
Rosalía's character performs on a pole.
Rosalía plays a dancer/stripper in Euphoria Season 3.
Rosalía's character wears a gemstone-encrusted neck brace throughout her appearance.
Rosalía appears in the trailer for Euphoria Season 3.
Euphoria Season 3 features a post-high school storyline.
Euphoria Season 3 is slated for a 2026 release.
Rosalía has a real-life friendship with Hunter Schafer.
Rosalía and Hunter Schafer previously dated.
Rosalía described a personal, unexpected connection to the role.
Rosalía described joining the show as a "major win".
